datasheet: JST SH connector catalogue 'eSH' (LCSC copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/40c649e22fa9bda892cfec952005fd51.pdf, sha256 27aaa74d..., same drawings as hardware/KiCad-Library/datasheet/JST-SH-SR-Series.pdf): p1 PC board layout, SMT top entry type (pads, tabs, 0.2 outline offset); p2 shrouded header table (BM04B-SRSS-TB: A 3.0, B 6.0) and top-entry drawing (depth 2.9, height 4.25, tails 0.7, circuit No.1)
derivation: origin midway between tab and signal-pad centres (EasyEDA C160390 uses the same origin, +-1.26); pin 1 at -x with the tails (+y) toward the viewer = JST circuit No.1; tabs numbered 5 (+x) and 6 (-x) like the OpenDrone SM04B part; body = header outline 6.0 x 2.9 from 0.2 inside the tab outer edge; mated height 6.3 (p1 assembly layout)
